name: @taruvi/tanstack-query
description: Framework-agnostic helpers for Taruvi. Provider methods return TanStack Query options. Functions, analytics, and file URL or download calls take the SDK client directly.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && mkdir -p dist/cjs && printf '%s\n' '{ "type": "commonjs" }' > dist/cjs/package.json
